prompts.cloud: Use case: texture-generation. Production seamless square albedo texture for a charming cel-shaded Godot cloud kingdom. Fill the entire image with close-up billowing cotton clouds: overlapping soft scalloped cushions, delicate airy wisps, subtle pearl ivory highlights, pale lavender-blue recesses, creamy white dominant colour. Almost flat evenly lit surface, gentle organic detail at multiple scales. Read as soft vapor, NEVER stone, rock, marble, cracked ground or foam bubbles. Orthographic overhead material sample, no sky, horizon, objects, text, frame or cast shadows. Seamless repeating on all four edges; no central recognizable focal feature. Keep medium-low contrast so game characters remain legible. Opaque square PNG.
